dimensions.dimension: Workload realism for ML inference on MCU-class devices
dimensions.achieves: CoreMark: ease of implementation, real algorithms, standard for MCU-class devices (E040). MLPerf inference: a benchmarking suite for ML inference (E042).
dimensions.shared_limitation: None gives small ML workloads that fit MCU-class devices: CoreMark does not represent ML inference; MLMark models are far too large (E041); the MLPerf inference benchmark precludes MCUs (E042).
dimensions.relation: MLPerf Tiny supplies small benchmarks with reference implementations for MCU-class devices.

dimensions.achieves: CoreMark has a power extension (ULPMark-CM) (E041). MLPerf inference had plans to add power measurements (E042).
dimensions.shared_limitation: MLMark does not support power measurement (E041).
dimensions.relation: MLPerf Tiny measures energy as a first-class quantity alongside latency and accuracy.

note: Built only from the MLPerf Tiny authors' own characterization of prior work (no source was read).
